items.title: Robotics startup Embo raises $110 million in seed funding to build world-model AI for robots
items.summary: Embo raised $110 million in seed funding to build a universal robot brain with world models. Its AI learns how the physical world works from internet video and practices motor skills in simulation.

items.title: Google Deepmind's "Humanity's First Exam" shows top AI models still fail simple everyday tasks under repeated runs
items.summary: Google Deepmind tests the reliability of 18 AI models with "Humanity's First Exam." Top models solve nearly every task family at least once, but even leaders like OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra stumble when asked for 16 straight correct answers. Visual perception accounts for 73 percent of errors, and more compute time doesn't fix the problem.
